block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: Tactical Grid Mechanics, TP Overworld Rules, Formations & ZOC Manifest
what_it_enables: Tactical Points (TP) economy: Spent to traverse the 2D grid and execute overworld actions
Overworld-to-battle state transitions affecting action-battle / side-scroll turn encounters
Tactical Ambush (15 TP): Grants first-strike initiative, +20% ATK, and 50% staggered foe poise
Tactical Scouting (10 TP): Reveals hazards and grants Fortune's Blessing (+30% LUK, +20% crit)
8-slot squad deployment matrix across Vanguard, Midline, and Rearguard positions
Zone-of-Control (ZOC) pin rules halting enemy traversal unless warded by Lux
invariants: Zero dynamic heap allocations in tactical pathfinding (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP)
Discrete Cartesian grid coordinates strictly bounded within [0, 64) x [0, 64)
Tactical Points (TP) budget strictly non-negative; conserved between grid and battle
Movement costs strictly scaled by terrain friction (friction >= 1.0)

subsystem.name: Tactical Strategy RPG Grid Mechanics & Formations Subsystem

actions.effect: Advances unit 1 tile on tactical grid
Doubles movement speed across open plains; inflicts -5% poise
Engages combat with First Strike, +20% ATK, 50% enemy stagger
Reveals fog-of-war cells and grants Fortune's Blessing (+30% LUK)
Fortifies ZOC perimeter; adds +20% Bastion DEF against flanking

catalogs.description: 8-slot squad tactical deployment matrix, line synergies, and buffs
Zone-of-Control interceptor rules, pin radius, and evasion penalties

tripwires.action: Trigger Tactical Exhaustion state (double movement cost, +20% MP cost)
